parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password or token for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the ONE_PASSWORD environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The ENDPOINT URL of the XMLRPC server. If not specified then the value of the ONE_URL environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The name of the user for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the ONE_USERNAME environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: user_primary_group - Resources belonging to the user’s primary group. user - Resources belonging to the user. all - All resources. user_groups - Resources belonging to the user and any of his groups. Choices: "user_primary_group" "user" ← (default) "all" "user_groups"

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A id of the template you would like to manage. If not set then a new template is created with the given name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A name of the template you would like to manage. If a template with the given name does not exist it is created, otherwise it is managed by this module.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: present - state that is used to manage the template. absent - delete the template. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: A string containing the template contents.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to validate the TLS/SSL certificates or not. This parameter is ignored if PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY environment variable is used. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: Time to wait for the desired state to be reached before timeout, in seconds. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Fetch the TEMPLATE by id
  community.general.one_template:
    id: 6459
  register: result

- name: Print the TEMPLATE properties
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: result

- name: Fetch the TEMPLATE by name
  community.general.one_template:
    name: tf-prd-users-workerredis-p6379a
  register: result

- name: Create a new or update an existing TEMPLATE
  community.general.one_template:
    name: generic-opensuse
    template: |
      CONTEXT = [
        HOSTNAME = "generic-opensuse"
      ]
      CPU = "1"
      CUSTOM_ATTRIBUTE = ""
      DISK = [
        CACHE = "writeback",
        DEV_PREFIX = "sd",
        DISCARD = "unmap",
        IMAGE = "opensuse-leap-15.2",
        IMAGE_UNAME = "oneadmin",
        IO = "threads",
        SIZE = "" ]
      MEMORY = "2048"
      NIC = [
        MODEL = "virtio",
        NETWORK = "testnet",
        NETWORK_UNAME = "oneadmin" ]
      OS = [
        ARCH = "x86_64",
        BOOT = "disk0" ]
      SCHED_REQUIREMENTS = "CLUSTER_ID=\\"100\\""
      VCPU = "2"

- name: Delete the TEMPLATE by id
  community.general.one_template:
    id: 6459
    state: absent

return_values.name: group_id
return_values.description: Template’s group ID. Returned: when state=present Sample: 1

return_values.name: group_name
return_values.description: Template’s group name. Returned: when state=present Sample: "one-users"

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Template ID. Returned: when state=present Sample: 153

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Template name. Returned: when state=present Sample: "app1"

return_values.name: owner_id
return_values.description: Template’s owner ID. Returned: when state=present Sample: 143

return_values.name: owner_name
return_values.description: Template’s owner name. Returned: when state=present Sample: "ansible-test"

return_values.name: template
return_values.description: The parsed template. Returned: when state=present
